description: This PHP class 'ProjectValidationEvent' performs validation and scoring of project data, including profile, overview, images, costs, rewards, and campaign information, for the Goteo crowdfunding platform.

classes.name: ProjectValidationEvent
classes.description: A class that validates and scores different aspects of a project for quality and completeness, used in the Goteo platform.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets validation scores, errors, and fields to initial state.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the validation keys to a custom list.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Returns the current list of validation keys.

methods.name: setFields
methods.description: Sets the form fields with errors.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the form fields with errors.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Calculates scores for each validation key and overall global score.

methods.name: getProfileScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on profile completeness and social links.

methods.name: getPersonalScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on personal information completeness.

methods.name: getOverviewScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on project overview completeness.

methods.name: getImagesScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on presence of project image.

methods.name: getCostsScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on completeness of costs information.

methods.name: getRewardsScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on rewards information.

methods.name: getCampaignScore
methods.description: Calculates score based on campaign contact info.
